auditory.description: Auditory input cortex: HGA + beta-ERD to the spoken prompt; silent to visual stimuli. Self-voice handled by auditory_feedback.

visual_picture.description: Visual cortex (picture): HGA across the image-viewing window; silent to the audio prompt.

visual_reading.description: Visual cortex (reading): HGA across the sentence-reading window; silent to the audio prompt.

lexical_semantic.description: Conceptual access at condition-specific times: picture early, audio mid-sentence, reading at the final blank.

heteromodal_convergence.description: Multimodal hub: HGA in mid-late perception across audio AND picture AND reading (convergent, not modality-selective).

maintenance.description: Working-memory hold: sustained HGA straddling the GO-cue, persisting from late perception into the early response.

phonological_encoding.description: Pre-articulatory phonological/phonetic encoding between the GO-cue (50%) and voice onset (~V%); condition-shared.

motor.description: Speech-motor cortex: HGA articulation at 60-85% with beta ERD (at most zero); silent during all stimulus windows.

auditory_feedback.description: Self-monitoring auditory cortex: HGA pos to the external prompt, HGA suppressed during own-voice articulation (all conds).

deactivation.description: Task-negative network: HGA suppression over the early-mid trial in all conditions (DMN-like deactivation).

tag_hga_activation.description: HGA increase in any stim or response window (no selectivity).

tag_beta_erd.description: Beta (13-30) ERD during any stimulus — engagement marker; contacts firing this with NO layer-1 HGA role are missed by a high-gamma-only filter (RQ1).

tag_low_f_erd.description: Delta/theta (1-8) ERD mid-trial — low-frequency network marker.

tag_theta_tracking.description: Theta (4-8) increase during the spoken prompt — syllabic-rate auditory tracking.

ultra_hfa.description: Ultra high-frequency activity (>200 Hz) in the middle 40% of any stimulus or response window (HFOs / very-high-gamma). NB: 200-400 Hz overlaps mains harmonics + speech EMG — interpret with care.

stimulus_responsive.description: HGA in the stimulus window of >=1 condition.

response_active.description: HGA in the response window of >=1 condition.
